Markets.title: Piramal Finance shares jump 4% as Q2 profit rises 67% YoY to Rs 545 crore, NII jumps 35% YoY
Markets.summary: Piramal Finance shares rose nearly 4% after its Q2 FY27 net profit surged 67% year-on-year to Rs 545 crore. The company also reported a 24% growth in assets under management and a 34% increase in retail disbursements.

Markets.title: EAAA India Alternatives fixes price band for Rs 1,200 IPO; issue opens on October 26
Markets.summary: EAAA India Alternatives has set a price band of Rs 1,585 to Rs 1,665 for its Rs 1,200-crore initial public offering, which opens on October 26. The entirely offer-for-sale public issue follows the company's reported increase in income and profit for fiscal year 2026.

Markets.title: Gold prices near Rs 1.47 lakh/10 grams, silver falls by Rs 1,144/kg as traders await Fed rate signals. What lies ahead?
Markets.summary: Gold prices edged lower and silver dropped by Rs 1,144 per kilogram on the MCX as traders awaited the US Federal Reserve's upcoming interest rate decision. While a stronger US dollar may cap gold's near-term gains, ongoing central bank buying continues to support longer-term prices.

Markets.title: Missed reversal in IT stocks? Jefferies gives 3 ideas with up to 50% re-rating potential
Markets.summary: Jefferies predicts further valuation growth for Indian IT stocks despite modest sector growth. The brokerage raised its target prices for Infosys and TCS, noting they offer over 20% rerating potential, while Sagility could achieve more than 50% in a best-case scenario.

Markets.title: Bajaj Finance shares fall 3% after Q2 results. What Jefferies, Nomura, other brokerages now expect?
Markets.summary: Bajaj Finance shares fell 3% after reporting a 29% increase in second-quarter net profit to Rs 6,367 crore. Nomura and Jefferies maintained their buy ratings, while 360 One WAM upgraded the stock to buy.

Markets.title: Transrail Lighting shares rally 9% after bagging orders worth Rs 927 crore
Markets.summary: Transrail Lighting shares jumped nearly 9% after the company secured new orders worth Rs 927 crore, bringing its total order intake for the fiscal year to Rs 3,356 crore. Despite this growth, foreign institutional investors reduced their stake in the company during the September 2026 quarter.

Geo-Political.title: US envoy arrives in Russia ahead of meeting with Putin as Zelensky says intelligence sharing 'works now'
Geo-Political.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff has arrived in St Petersburg to discuss proposals for ending the conflict in Ukraine with Russian leadership. Meanwhile, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that intelligence sharing between his country and its allies is now functioning effectively.

Geo-Political.title: France is divided over who to blame for weekend riots and what to learn from them
Geo-Political.summary: France is deeply divided over the causes of the recent severe urban riots and the lessons that should be learned from the unrest. People both within and outside the country hold conflicting views regarding who is to blame for the violence.

Geo-Political.title: Elon Musk considering Tesla-SpaceX merger
Geo-Political.summary: Elon Musk announced that Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to evaluate a potential mega-merger between the two companies. The proposed combination would unite Musk's major electric vehicle and aerospace enterprises under a single corporate structure.

Geo-Political.title: Pakistan arrests man hunted by US over $126m postage fraud case
Geo-Political.summary: Pakistani authorities have arrested Faheem Akram, a man wanted by the United States for allegedly orchestrating a $126 million postage fraud scheme. Akram is accused of selling more than five million counterfeit postage labels for $2 each.

Geo-Political.title: Trump and Zelensky appear at loggerheads despite Oslo optimism
Geo-Political.summary: Despite positive moments in Oslo, including a hug with US envoy Steve Witkoff, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Donald Trump remain at odds. Misgivings about future US policy toward Ukraine persist despite these diplomatic interactions.

Geo-Political.title: Sudan army drones hit mourners and fuel market killing more than 300 people, sources say
Geo-Political.summary: Sudan army drone strikes killed more than 300 people by targeting a truck carrying mourners to a funeral and a market supplying fuel to the Rapid Support Forces. The attacks caused massive casualties among civilians and local merchants.

Data & Insights.summary: The government is overhauling tax refund schemes for exporters and has established two panels to manage the process. This decision follows a late last month recommendation by the expenditure finance committee to achieve better targeting and optimal fund utilization.

Data & Insights.summary: Despite the global economy's resilience in 2026, ongoing volatility and unpredictability are expected to impact India's growth trajectory. These unpredictable global economic conditions could create challenges for India's future development.

Data & Insights.summary: India and New Zealand's free trade agreement takes effect on October 20, granting Indian exports full duty-free access. The pact targets bilateral trade of about ₹35,000 crore by 2030.

Data & Insights.title: Amitabh Kant on how India’s semiconductor future is taking shape: 6 states with 12 projects,  ₹1.64 lakh cr investments
Data & Insights.summary: India has secured 12 semiconductor projects worth ₹1.64 lakh crore across six states. Gujarat leads this initiative as the country's largest hub with six approved projects, highlighted by a ₹91,526 crore fabrication plant by Tata-PSMC.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: No tariff on Indian exports from Oct 20; Textile, pharma, leather exports to gain market access
Data & Insights.summary: Starting October 20, the India-New Zealand FTA will eliminate tariffs on all Indian exports to New Zealand. This agreement is expected to boost sectors such as textiles, leather, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture while strengthening bilateral trade.

Data & Insights.title: Is India’s solar power play facing its Icarus moment?
Data & Insights.summary: India's electricity grid is failing to keep up with the rapid growth of the country's solar power sector. The government must quickly resolve these infrastructure bottlenecks to prevent them from derailing national clean energy goals.

India.title: UGC NET December 2026: Full List Of Maharashtra Exam Centres For Candidates
India.summary: Candidates applying for the UGC NET December 2026 exam must choose four cities of their preference. The National Testing Agency has released the full list of exam centres available in Maharashtra for this test.

India.title: Irked By Fight Over Mobile, Karnataka Man Rams Truck Into Friend's Scooter, 2 Dead
India.summary: A Karnataka man rammed his truck into his friend's scooter in Mangaluru on Monday evening following an argument over a mobile phone. The collision resulted in the deaths of two people.

India.title: Day After Amit Shah's Visit, CBI Takes Over Punjab Activist's Murder Case
India.summary: Following a visit by Amit Shah, the CBI has taken over the murder case of Punjab activist Parvinder Singh Jhota. The transfer responds to demands from his family and political leaders for an independent investigation.

India.summary: Vellore Institute of Technology has opened registration for its 2027 engineering entrance examination. Candidates will receive four marks for each correct answer and lose one mark for each incorrect answer.
